hook.say: Japan's ten highest mountains, ranked. Number one towers almost 600 meters above all the others!

outro.say: Would you climb Mount Fuji? Comment below!

items.name: Mount Obami
items.fact: On the ridge to Mount Yari
items.say: Number ten: Mount Oh-bah-mee, on the ridge to Mount Yari. 3101 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Mount Ōbami, on the ridge to Mount Yari. 3,101 meters.

items.name: Mount Kitahotaka
items.fact: North peak of the Hotaka group
items.say: Nine: Kee-tah-hoe-tah-kah, the north peak of the Hotaka group. 3106 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Kitahotaka, the north peak of the Hotaka group. 3,106 meters.

items.name: Mount Karasawa
items.say: Eight: Mount Kah-rah-sah-wah, above a famous glacial bowl. 3110 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Mount Karasawa, above a famous glacial bowl. 3,110 meters.

items.name: Mount Akaishi
items.say: Seven: Mount Ah-kah-ee-shee. Its name means red stone. 3121 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Mount Akaishi. Its name means red stone. 3,121 meters.

items.name: Mount Warusawa
items.say: Six: Mount Wah-roo-sah-wah, deep in the Southern Alps. 3141 meters.
items.cap: Six: Mount Warusawa, deep in the Southern Alps. 3,141 meters.

items.name: Mount Yari
items.say: Five: Mount Yari, the Matterhorn of Japan. 3180 meters.
items.cap: Five: Mount Yari, the Matterhorn of Japan. 3,180 meters.

items.name: Mount Aino
items.say: Four: Mount Eye-no, tied for third place. 3190 meters.
items.cap: Four: Mount Aino, tied for third place. 3,190 meters.

items.name: Mount Okuhotaka
items.say: Three: Oh-koo-hoe-tah-kah, the top of the Northern Alps. Also 3190 meters.
items.cap: Three: Okuhotaka, the top of the Northern Alps. Also 3,190 meters.

items.name: Mount Kita
items.say: Two: Mount Kita, Japan's highest peak that is not a volcano. 3193 meters.
items.cap: Two: Mount Kita, Japan's highest peak that is not a volcano. 3,193 meters.

items.name: Mount Fuji
items.say: And number one: Mount Fuji! 3776 meters, Japan's sacred volcano.
items.cap: And number one: Mount Fuji! 3,776 meters, Japan's sacred volcano.
